attributes.action: Reform child protection and increase sentences for serious offences
attributes.additional_details: Tragic child abuse cases have highlighted weaknesses in safeguarding. We urge the Government to strengthen vetting, monitoring and accountability in adoption and foster care, and ensure the most serious crimes against children receive the toughest sentences available. UK inquiries into grooming gangs and child sexual exploitation cases have highlighted repeated failures in safeguarding, reporting and agency response. It’s time to act today, not tomorrow for future generations.
attributes.background: Every child deserves to be safe. We believe stronger safeguarding, improved oversight and tougher sentencing for the most serious crimes against children are needed to prevent future tragedies and restore public confidence in child protection.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Review and improve safeguarding for children before and after adoption" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775263

We can also only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for. Sentencing decisions are a matter for the courts.
